facts.fact: Algérie Presse Service reports the national addressing reference holds 1.5 million official, unified, geolocatable addresses, including over 415,000 in pilot wilaya Oran, per the Interior Ministry's official.
A national plan to cover all 69 wilayas by 2030 was presented; rollout is engaged in 12 wilayas and 13 more are budgeted, says the Interior Ministry's official.
